name: Daily API Data Sync
description: Scheduled workflow that pulls fresh data from a partner API every morning and forwards it to an internal endpoint.
expected_documentation:
# Daily API Data Sync

## Overview
Mirrors the partner orders feed into the internal system once a day so downstream services work from fresh data.

## Prerequisites
Requires the PARTNER_TOKEN secret for partner authentication, and reaches partner.example.com and internal.example.com.

## Trigger
Cron Trigger — fires daily at 09:00 (cron `0 9 * * *`).

## Walkthrough
1. Every Morning (Cron Trigger) starts the run on schedule.
2. Fetch Orders (HTTP Request) issues a GET to the partner orders API using a bearer token from the PARTNER_TOKEN secret and emits the response body.
3. Forward to Ingest (HTTP Request) POSTs that body to the internal ingestion endpoint.

## Data Flow
Fetch Orders' response body ({{steps.fetch.body}}) becomes the request body of Forward to Ingest.

## Decisions
None.

## Error Handling
None configured: a partner outage fails at Fetch Orders; an internal failure does not roll back the partner side.
